content.title: Bitcoin Keeps Falling. Blame Gold and Silver.
content.summary: Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies were little changed on Christmas Eve, with digital assets looking set to miss out on any Santa Claus rally that sweeps stock markets.  The price of  Bitcoin  fell less than 1% over the past 24 hours to $87,300.  Bitcoin hit a record high above $126,000 in October but has since fallen back dramatically amid deteriorating sentiment for digital assets.
